name: plumbing-homepage
description: Static HTML homepage with locally compiled Tailwind CSS

scripts.format: prettier --write index.html assets/site.js assets/site-config.js styles/theme.css scripts/check.mjs preview.mjs package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html assets/site.js assets/site-config.js styles/theme.css scripts/check.mjs preview.mjs package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: node --check assets/site.js && node --check assets/site-config.js && node scripts/check.mjs
